data.name: Skill unlock spellcraft 20 Ranks
data.description: Whenever you attempt a caster level check, attempt a Spellcraft check at a -20 penalty at the same DC. If the spellcraft check succeeds, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your caster level check.
